vBRIEFInfo.author: agent:deft-directive-setup
vBRIEFInfo.description: Proxy mode: ghproxy + gitea-mirror + Caddyfile proxy routing

narrative.Overview: Add the proxy profile services (ghproxy via wjqserver/ghproxy, gitea-mirror) to docker-compose.yml and extend Caddyfile to route git/raw/release traffic to ghproxy. After this scope, docker compose --profile proxy up -d produces a fully working proxy+mirror stack. Depends on: bootstrap-entrypoint.
narrative.Traces: FR-1 (proxy mode), FR-2 (proxy Docker Compose profile), FR-7 (gitea-mirror sync), FR-8 (ghproxy cache/rate-limit/metrics), FR-9 (Caddyfile proxy routing), FR-10 (.env.example proxy vars), NFR-2 (China-optimised cache sizing)

items.title: docker-compose.yml — ghproxy service (proxy profile)
items.description: Add ghproxy service: image wjqserver/ghproxy, profiles: [proxy], restart: unless-stopped, network gjgit. Mount configs/ghproxy/ for config file. Expose :9090 for Prometheus (internal only). Configure via environment or config file: cache path + size from GH_PROXY_CACHE_SIZE, rate limit from GH_PROXY_RATE_LIMIT_RPS. Add ghproxy_cache named volume.

items.title: configs/ghproxy/ — ghproxy config
items.description: Create configs/ghproxy/config.yaml (or equivalent config format for wjqserver/ghproxy). Enable hybrid cache, set disk path to /var/cache/ghproxy (volume-mounted), enable Prometheus on :9090, configure rate limiting. Add configs/ghproxy/config.yaml.example as the committed template. Research wjqserver/ghproxy config schema before writing.

items.title: docker-compose.yml — gitea-mirror service (proxy profile)
items.description: Add gitea-mirror service: image ghcr.io/raylabshq/gitea-mirror:latest, profiles: [proxy], env_file: .env, mounts shared_token volume at /shared, depends_on bootstrap (service_completed_successfully), restart: unless-stopped, network gjgit. Service reads FORGEJO_TOKEN from /shared/forgejo-token at startup — document how gitea-mirror consumes the token file.

items.title: .env.example — proxy mode section
items.description: Add PROXY MODE section to .env.example: GITHUB_REPO, GITHUB_TOKEN, MIRROR_INTERVAL (default 15m), MIRROR_ISSUES, MIRROR_RELEASES, MIRROR_LFS. Add HIGH-VOLUME TWEAKS section: GH_PROXY_CACHE_SIZE (default 20G), GH_PROXY_RATE_LIMIT_RPS (default 200). All with inline comments.

items.title: Caddyfile — proxy mode routing
items.description: Extend Caddyfile with a conditional block (using Caddy's named matchers) that routes *.git paths, /*/archive/*, /*/releases/*, raw.githubusercontent.com proxied paths to ghproxy:8080. Web UI paths (/, /user*, /explore*, /issues*, /notifications*) continue routing to forgejo:3000. Add clear comments delineating standalone vs proxy routing sections.

items.title: Caddy service — add ghproxy depends_on (proxy profile)
items.description: Update caddy service in docker-compose.yml to conditionally depend_on ghproxy when proxy profile is active. Since Docker Compose profiles don't support conditional depends_on natively, document the workaround (start order via healthcheck or accept that caddy starts before ghproxy is ready with retry logic).
